answer: Closed in d-kit: one verb (`zmux <project>.<id> [cmd]`) plus three small integrations and a vocabulary document, packaged in the flake. No picker (zp), no agent tools (pi-zmx), no TUI, no manifest, and no `zmux ls` in v0 — a non-interactive reader is deferred until a script actually needs one, since `zmx ls` plus awk already answers most questions and zp answers the interactive ones.
body: Whether zmux is one command or one command plus a reader.
title: What is the irreducible zmux?
